plugin.note: Bring a crystal chime. Tortoises are simple with prayer melee or Ranged/Magic safespots; terrorbirds require earmuffs or Slayer helmet and can be handled with prayer/pathing safespots or cannoning.

requirements: Warped Reality unlock for 60 Slayer reward points
Crystal chime in inventory to damage Warped creatures
Earmuffs or Slayer helmet recommended for Warped Terrorbirds
Bigger and Badder for Mutated Tortoise and Mutated Terrorbird superior spawns
mechanics: Warped creatures are found exclusively in the Poison Waste Dungeon.
Without a crystal chime in inventory, Warped creatures are invulnerable.
Warped Tortoises only use melee and their damage is fully negated by Protect from Melee.
Warped Tortoises have a 20% elemental weakness to earth spells.
Warped Terrorbirds use melee and ranged and switch to the style not protected against.
Earmuffs or Slayer helmet halve Warped Terrorbird max hit and reduce chip damage through Protect from Missiles.
Warped Terrorbirds never lose aggression, which makes many dungeon areas poor safespots.
Mutated Tortoise and Mutated Terrorbird are superior variants from Bigger and Badder.

methods.label: Requirements and unlock
methods.summary: Unlock Warped Reality, complete The Path of Glouphrie, and carry a crystal chime before fighting any Warped creature.
requiredOrKeyItems: Earmuffs for terrorbird travel or combat
steps: Confirm 56 Slayer and The Path of Glouphrie access.
Purchase Warped Reality for 60 Slayer reward points.
Bring the crystal chime in inventory or the monsters are invulnerable.
Wear Slayer helmet or bring earmuffs when running through or fighting terrorbirds.
Bring High Level Alchemy runes if staying for valuable drops.

methods.label: Prayer melee tortoise
methods.summary: Use Protect from Melee and a crush-leaning melee setup on Warped Tortoises for the simplest low-attention task path.
recommendedFor: players staying near the dungeon entrance
requiredOrKeyItems: Prayer potions or moonlight moth mixes
Teleport to a bank and spirit tree
prayers: Offensive melee prayers if supply state allows
steps: Fight tortoises near the entrance or deeper tortoise rooms.
Activate Protect from Melee to nullify their only attack style.
Use a crush weapon where available because tortoises have no crush defence bonus.
Prioritise prayer bonus for longer AFK time.
Use High Level Alchemy on valuable drops to extend trips.
notes: Maces are useful budget options because they can provide prayer bonus.
The task page uses Sarachnis cudgel as the example melee weapon.

methods.label: Ranged tortoise safespot
methods.summary: Safespot Warped Tortoises around the pillar room and kill them with Ranged without taking damage.
steps: Travel to the tortoise safespot room around x=1505, y=4282.
Wear earmuffs or Slayer helmet while passing terrorbirds.
Stand behind the pillars so tortoises cannot reach you.
Use a fast ranged weapon; heavy ranged weakness exists, but fast weapons can outperform slow crossbows.
Use Eagle Eye or equivalent if bringing prayer restoration.
notes: If using Eclipse atlatl, bring both Ranging potion and Super strength potion.

methods.label: Magic tortoise safespot
methods.summary: Safespot Warped Tortoises with Magic, using earth spells or powered staves depending on gear and Magic level.
requiredOrKeyItems: Twinflame staff or earth spell setup
prayers: Mystic Might if using prayer restoration
steps: Use the same tortoise safespot room around x=1505, y=4282.
Cast earth spells with Twinflame staff or another earth setup to exploit the elemental weakness.
At higher Magic levels, compare powered staves such as Trident of the seas or Trident of the swamp.
Use Magic potion or Forgotten brew if it creates meaningful powered-staff DPS gains.
notes: The task page notes Eye of ayak as an exception for terrorbird safespot reach; ordinary cast spells can reach.

methods.label: Terrorbird prayer safespot
methods.summary: Use earmuffs or Slayer helmet, then manipulate Warped Terrorbird prayer reactions so ranged attackers attempt melee pathing and become stuck.
requiredOrKeyItems: 9 tile range weapon such as Crystal bow or Craw's bow
Crossbow or shortbow on Longrange if needed
prayers: Avoid Protect from Melee after the safespot is established
steps: Open the two doors near the first terrorbird room and lure several terrorbirds.
Stand 9 tiles away near the warped tortoise or use a corner/waste-pit setup.
Use Protect from Missiles briefly so ranged terrorbirds switch to melee pathing.
Let unreachable terrorbirds become stuck rather than switching back to ranged.
Do not use Protect from Melee after setting this up, because terrorbirds react to prayer and switch styles.
risks: Without earmuffs or Slayer helmet, their ranged chip damage is more dangerous.
Shortbows and crossbows need Longrange to reach some door safespots, reducing DPS.

methods.label: Terrorbird cannoning
methods.summary: Place a cannon around 1490,4263 and stand by a wall or waste pit so many cannon-targeted terrorbirds path behind obstacles.
steps: Set the cannon near 1490,4263 on the main level.
Stand against a wall or waste pit.
Let cannon-targeted terrorbirds path around the waste pit and block each other.
Use Protect from Missiles when ranged chip damage is possible.
Finish reachable terrorbirds while the cannon handles pathing pressure.
risks: The task page marks terrorbird safespotting as conditional rather than guaranteed.
Poor standing position can let multiple terrorbirds reach melee distance.

methods.label: Superior variants
methods.summary: Handle Mutated Tortoise and Mutated Terrorbird as Bigger and Badder superior spawns using the corresponding regular-monster plan.
steps: For Mutated Tortoise, continue using Protect from Melee or safespot methods.
For Mutated Terrorbird, keep the terrorbird prayer/pathing rules in mind.
Expect superior monsters to roll three additional regular-table drops plus the superior unique table.
notes: Mutated Tortoise has a 25% elemental weakness to earth spells.
